notes.uv: u,v,w,h are fractions of the sheet with (0,0) at the TOP-LEFT texel. Load signs.png with tex.flipY=false, exactly as js/atlas.js does, or every region is upside down.
notes.greyscale: One channel. Multiply by a per-instance emissive tint; never bake colour.
notes.mip: Build texture.mipmaps by hand and stop at mipLevels. Beyond that the 4px padding ring is under one texel and regions bleed into each other.
notes.mode: "tube" = AdditiveBlending, sample.r IS the glow. "box" = lit lightbox panel: the region background (black here) glows and the white marks are the dark artwork cut out of it.
notes.wrapU: ticker regions are horizontally periodic and their side padding holds the wrapped continuation, so U may be scrolled and wrapped inside the region seamlessly.
notes.aspect: World quad size is bandHeight * aspect (§3.5.1).
